steps.en: Set MySQL binlog to row format with a full row image, and create the ES indices and mappings
steps.zh: binlog 设为 row 格式、full 镜像，建好 ES 索引和映射

steps.en: Build the binary and list which tables go to which index in the TOML config
steps.zh: 编出二进制，在 TOML 配置里写清哪些表进哪个索引

steps.en: Start it next to a local mysqldump
steps.zh: 在装有 mysqldump 的机器上启动它

steps.en: Runs mysqldump once and indexes every existing row, keyed by its primary key
steps.zh: 先跑一次 mysqldump，把现有行按主键写成 ES 文档

steps.en: Joins as a fake replica and turns each binlog row event into batched ES bulk requests
steps.zh: 伪装成从库读 binlog，把每个行事件攒成批量请求写进 ES

steps.en: Saves the binlog position to master.info so a restart resumes where it stopped
steps.zh: 把 binlog 位点存进 master.info，重启后从断点续传

value.en: Elasticsearch follows MySQL on its own — your app writes to one database instead of two
value.zh: ES 自动跟着 MySQL 变，应用只写一个库，不用双写

sources: https://github.com/go-mysql-org/go-mysql-elasticsearch#notice (row binlog, full row image, PK as id, mysqldump on same node, MySQL < 8.0, ES < 6.0)
https://github.com/go-mysql-org/go-mysql-elasticsearch/blob/master/river/sync.go (OnRow → elastic.BulkRequest, bulk_size / flush_bulk_time) and river/master.go (master.info position file)
